hook.text: When Napping Hurts: effective learning usually works differently from what feels easiest.

buildup.text: When Napping Hurts sets up the method, the mechanism, and the learning tradeoff.

discovery.text: When Napping Hurts reveals the principle that makes the learning stick.

twist.text: For people with insomnia, napping perpetuates the cycle. Less nighttime sleep pressure means worse insomnia.

climax.text: Nap before 3 PM, keep it under 30 minutes, and skip it entirely if you already struggle with nighttime sleep.

punchline.text: Early and short. Otherwise, the nap becomes the problem.

quiz.question: Why can late-afternoon napping worsen sleep quality?
options: The brain cannot nap after 3 PM
It reduces adenosine sleep pressure, pushing bedtime later
Daylight during naps confuses the circadian clock permanently
